# SM-04 — Outbound resilience

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app calls any external service.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
A timeout on every outbound call.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-04-L1** Every outbound call has an explicit timeout; a stubbed hanging dependency fails within it. | auto + review | `test_report` |

## Full
Lite, plus retries only for safe operations, with exponential backoff, jitter, a cap and a maximum attempt count.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-04-F1** With a stubbed failing dependency, safe calls retry with backoff and stop at the cap; unsafe calls never retry. | auto | `test_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- HTTP clients or service SDKs
  - code: `\bfrom ['"](axios|undici|got|node-fetch|openai|@anthropic-ai/sdk|stripe)['"]`
  - code: `\bimport (requests|httpx)\b`
